headline: A formal companion to the 2026 counterexamples to Connes rigidity
claimBoundary: The public counterexamples are external results. This repository separately labels Lean-checked theorems, exact finite computations, unreviewed proof candidates, refuted formulations, and open construction steps.

lean.fullBuild: green on the exact release candidate head

claims.name: Two counterexamples to the broad ICC property-(T) rigidity conjecture were reported
claims.evidence: Independent constructions were reported in 2026. Their operator-algebraic conclusions are prior art and are not reproved by this repository.

claims.name: Canonical group-algebra bialgebra structure reconstructs the group
claims.evidence: The full pinned Lean graph checks the restriction to group-like elements and the induced group isomorphism. The statement assumes preservation of the canonical coproduct.

claims.name: A nonzero first-two-symmetric rank-three polynomial tensor has infinite elementary orbit
claims.evidence: Lean checks an explicit elementary-transvection tail with infinite range over every field. The arbitrary-rank generalization is not included in this status.

claims.name: The shifted ternary carry extension has exponent dividing nine
claims.evidence: The checked cocycle chain proves the multiplication-by-three identity, exponent bound, three-torsion characterization, and shifted-kernel cardinality 3^(3n).

claims.name: Selected prime, rank, degree, and Witt cases reproduce exactly
claims.evidence: Eleven deterministic certificate suites pass on their declared bounded domains. No conclusion is extended beyond those domains by computation alone.

claims.name: Stable and odd-critical divided-power cyclicity
claims.evidence: A written induction and selected exact certificates support the claim. The general theorem is not yet formalized or independently reviewed.

claims.name: General stable and critical polynomial-tensor orbit theorem
claims.evidence: A coordinate-block argument extends the checked rank-three pattern on paper. Only the rank-three critical case is presently Lean checked.

claims.name: An untwisted linear cubic retraction works over every characteristic-three field
claims.evidence: The checked scalar obstruction shows that such a map forces x^3=x for every scalar. A general formulation needs a Frobenius twist.

claims.name: A completed prime-uniform property-(T) counterexample family
claims.evidence: The synthesis still depends on unformalized group-theoretic and operator-algebraic interfaces, specialist review, and a stronger novelty audit.
